 Summit Hotel Properties announces CFO appointment, COO promotion
 Less than 1 min read INN Key points: Summit Hotel Properties appointed Mike Nieves as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective November 1, 2026. 
 Nieves joins from PENN Entertainment, where he served as senior vice president of Finance and Treasurer. 
 Adam Wudel has been promoted to executive vice president and chief operating officer, also effective November 1, 2026. 
 Wudel brings 18 years of experience at Summit and most recently served as EVP of Corporate Development, overseeing asset management, revenue strategy, data analytics, and transactions.
